title: Ambassadors
content:
Hippocrates Ambassadors

A different vision of wellness, shared in your own voice

Hippocrates partners with a small number of creators and educators whose work already speaks to the people we hope to reach. If that sounds like yours, tell us about it. Express interest→ See who we partner with→
The partnership

For Life! The Hippocrates Wellness Alumni Community, for everyone who has walked the campus and carried it home.

Help us build a lasting home for the deepest work that happens here. Your gift to the campus shapes the physical place where the next seventy years of healing will unfold, for every guest who walks through the door after you. You came as a guest. You leave as family. And family always has a way home.
Who we partner with

What we look for

01 An established platform A channel, publication or podcast you have built and continue to publish on. 02 A community that listens People who take your recommendations seriously — whatever the size of the audience. 03 Relevant subject matter Wellness, nutrition, education, longevity or lifestyle work that sits naturally alongside ours. 04 Honest storytelling You are comfortable describing an experience as you found it, including the parts that surprised you. 05 Program Work you are proud of, produced to a standard you control. 06 Genuine curiosity An interest in experiencing Hippocrates firsthand before speaking about it.
How it works

Experience first. Story second.

There are moments when an institution must do more than celebrate its past. Partners are like-minded individuals or companies wanting to collaborate to
  1. Share the Story: we grow through the people and organizations who share our vision;
  2. Build a relationship with the outcome of connecting people to better opportunity for optimal health.
We partner across every kind of alignment — from clinical and wellness innovators like Dr Jan Hrnrenky, BrainTap and the Longevity Center, to influential voices such as Jeff Beacher and Jen Heller, to retreat and creative collaborators including Loren Lahav and Stay True Creative Productions. We're also proud to partner with Kaia Roman on the documentary Frequency. As the movement grows, so do the opportunities to align — and they are endless.
Express interest

Tell us about your work

We are always looking for relationships with like-minded, heart-centered, community focused wellness providers and organizations. Arrangements, expectations and terms are shared privately with partners we take forward. Nothing about them is published here. Fields marked are required. We don’t ask for health, medical or financial information here. *
What happens next

After you submit

01

We read it

Every submission is reviewed by the team. 02

We may get in touch

If there looks to be a fit, someone will reach out for a conversation. 03

Details come then

Arrangements and expectations are discussed privately, with partners we take forward.

	/* A tutta pagina, indipendente dal Container che ospita il widget.
	   Il kit Elementor applica a ogni Container un padding laterale
	   clamp(1rem,.5rem + 1.5vw,2rem): senza questa regola ogni sezione
	   mostrerebbe due bande ai lati, e andrebbe azzerato a mano 43 volte.
	   La larghezza si prende dal viewport e i margini negativi annullano
	   qualunque padding il genitore imponga. */
	.hw-scope.hw-fullbleed{width:100vw;max-width:100vw;
	  margin-inline:calc(50% - 50vw)}
	/* impaginazione */
	.hw-scope .hw-container{width:100%;max-width:var(--container-main);
	  margin-inline:auto;padding-inline:var(--gutter)}
	/* Il contenitore largo del design system: 1440px invece di 1200. Serve
	   alla striscia dei fatti sotto l'hero, che a 1200 non ci sta su una
	   riga e va a capo — nel prototipo le quattro voci sono affiancate. */
	.hw-scope .hw-container--wide{max-width:var(--container-wide)}
	.hw-scope.hw-section{padding-block:var(--space-section);
	  background:var(--color-bg-primary)}
	.hw-scope.hw-section--secondary{background:var(--color-bg-secondary)}
	.hw-scope.hw-section--dark{background:var(--color-bg-dark);
	  color:var(--color-text-light)}
	/* Stava dentro due widget, e chi ne usava un terzo su fondo immersivo si
	   ritrovava testo chiaro su carta chiara. Le quattro superfici di pagina
	   sono una scelta del design system: appartengono alla base, non a un
	   componente che per caso e in pagina. */
	.hw-scope.hw-section--immersive{background:var(--color-bg-immersive);
	  color:var(--color-text-light)}
	/* Le righe etichetta/valore le stampa hw_righe_elenco(), che e condivisa
	   fra griglia e split: il loro vestito sta qui, non dentro un widget che
	   potrebbe non essere in pagina. */
	.hw-scope .hw-card__dl{margin:0;display:grid;gap:.5rem}
	.hw-scope .hw-card__dl dt{font-family:var(--font-ui);
	  font-size:var(--fs-caption);font-weight:var(--fw-semibold);
	  text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:var(--ls-eyebrow);
	  color:var(--color-text-muted);margin:0}
	.hw-scope .hw-card__dl dd{margin:0;font-family:var(--font-body);
	  font-size:var(--fs-body-sm);line-height:var(--lh-body);
	  color:var(--color-text-secondary)}
	/* tipografia */
	.hw-scope .hw-eyebrow{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;
	  gap:var(--space-xs);font-family:var(--font-ui);font-size:var(--fs-eyebrow);
	  font-weight:var(--fw-semibold);letter-spacing:var(--ls-eyebrow);
	  text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--color-accent-strong)}
	.hw-scope .hw-eyebrow--soft{color:var(--color-accent)}
	.hw-scope .hw-h2{font-family:var(--font-heading);font-size:var(--fs-h2);
	  font-weight:var(--fw-regular);line-height:var(--lh-heading);
	  letter-spacing:var(--ls-heading);color:var(--color-text-primary);
	  /* 19em, non 26ch: in `ch` la misura dipende dalle metriche del font
	     servito, e a 26ch «What a stay at Hippocrates feels like» andava a
	     capo mentre nel prototipo sta su una riga. Il prototipo arriva a 34ch
	     sui titoli piu lunghi; qui una misura sola, larga abbastanza per
	     quelli brevi e ancora stretta per i discorsivi. */
	  margin:var(--space-xs) 0 0;max-width:19em;text-wrap:balance}
	.hw-scope .hw-body{font-family:var(--font-body);font-size:var(--fs-body-lg);

	.hw-scope .hw-actions{display:flex;gap:var(--space-sm);flex-wrap:wrap;
	  margin-top:var(--space-lg);align-items:center}
	.hw-scope .hw-actions a,.hw-scope .hw-textlink{text-decoration:none;
	  font-family:var(--font-ui);font-weight:var(--fw-semibold);
	  letter-spacing:var(--ls-button);display:inline-flex;align-items:center;
	  gap:var(--space-2xs);
	  transition:background var(--dur-base) var(--ease-standard),
	             color var(--dur-base) var(--ease-standard)}
	.hw-scope .hw-btn--primary{background:var(--color-interactive);

	/* Il secondo pulsante su fondo scuro: stesso ingombro del primo, peso
	   diverso. Il bordo e a piena opacita perche su una fotografia un bordo
	   sbiadito sparisce, e con lui l'affordance. */
	.hw-scope .hw-btn--outline-light-lg{background:transparent;

	.hw-scope .hw-btn--outline:hover{background:var(--color-interactive);
	  color:var(--color-text-light)}
	.hw-scope .hw-textlink{color:var(--color-link);font-size:var(--fs-button);
	  border-bottom:1.5px solid;padding-bottom:2px}
	.hw-scope .hw-textlink:hover{color:var(--color-link-hover);
	  border-bottom-color:var(--color-link-hover)}
	.hw-scope .hw-textlink--light{color:var(--color-text-light)}
	.hw-scope .hw-textlink--light:hover{color:var(--clay-200);
	  border-bottom-color:var(--clay-200)}
	/* Elenchi puntati. Il marcatore e disegnato, non scritto: un carattere
	   nel contenuto verrebbe letto ad alta voce a ogni riga, e un simbolo
	   ripetuto venti volte e rumore, non informazione. */
	.hw-scope .hw-nota.hw-nota--azione{margin-top:var(--space-sm);
	  font-family:var(--font-ui);font-size:var(--fs-body-sm);
	  color:var(--color-text-muted);max-width:60ch}
	.hw-scope.hw-section--dark .hw-nota--azione,
	.hw-scope.hw-section--immersive .hw-nota--azione{
	  color:var(--color-text-light-secondary)}
	.hw-scope .hw-lista{list-style:none;margin:var(--space-sm) 0 0;padding:0;
	  display:grid;gap:var(--space-2xs)}
	.hw-scope .hw-lista li{position:relative;padding-left:1.7rem;
	  font-family:var(--font-body);font-size:var(--fs-body);
	  line-height:var(--lh-body);color:var(--color-text-secondary)}
	.hw-scope .hw-lista li::before{content:"";position:absolute;left:.3rem;
	  top:calc(var(--lh-body) * .5em - .19rem);width:.38rem;height:.38rem;
	  background:var(--color-accent);transform:rotate(45deg)}
	/* variante con la spunta: due lati di un quadrato, ruotati */
	.hw-scope .hw-lista--punto li::before{width:.3rem;height:.3rem;
	  border-radius:50%;transform:none;background:var(--color-text-muted);
	  top:calc(var(--lh-body) * .5em - .15rem)}
	.hw-scope .hw-lista--check li::before{width:.34rem;height:.62rem;
	  background:none;border:solid var(--clay-400);border-width:0 2px 2px 0;
	  transform:rotate(42deg);left:.34rem;
	  top:calc(var(--lh-body) * .5em - .44rem)}
	.hw-scope.hw-section--dark .hw-lista li,
	.hw-scope.hw-section--immersive .hw-lista li{color:var(--sand-100)}
	/* Su fondo scuro i pulsanti cambiano verso. Il verde del marchio non si
	   stacca dal verde della sezione, e un link verde scuro su verde scuro
	   non si vede affatto: sono tre classi perche devono battere le regole
	   di base, che ne hanno due. */
	.hw-scope.hw-section--dark .hw-btn--primary,
	.hw-scope.hw-section--immersive .hw-btn--primary{
	  background:var(--color-text-light);color:var(--green-800);
	  border-color:var(--color-text-light)}
	.hw-scope.hw-section--dark .hw-btn--primary:hover,
	.hw-scope.hw-section--immersive .hw-btn--primary:hover{
	  background:var(--sand-200);border-color:var(--sand-200);
	  color:var(--green-800);box-shadow:none}
	.hw-scope.hw-section--dark .hw-btn--outline,
	.hw-scope.hw-section--immersive .hw-btn--outline{
	  color:var(--color-text-light);border-color:var(--color-text-light);
	  background:transparent}
	.hw-scope.hw-section--dark .hw-btn--outline:hover,
	.hw-scope.hw-section--immersive .hw-btn--outline:hover{
	  background:rgba(246,243,236,.12);color:var(--color-text-light)}
	.hw-scope.hw-section--dark .hw-textlink,
	.hw-scope.hw-section--immersive .hw-textlink{color:var(--color-text-light)}
	.hw-scope.hw-section--dark .hw-textlink:hover,
	.hw-scope.hw-section--immersive .hw-textlink:hover{
	  color:var(--clay-200);border-bottom-color:var(--clay-200)}
	/* Anteprima di un video. Il triangolo e il velo dicono che si apre
	   qualcosa: senza, una foto ferma resta solo una foto. */
	.hw-scope .hw-poster{position:relative;display:block;width:100%;padding:0;
	  border:0;border-radius:var(--radius-lg);overflow:hidden;
	  background:var(--green-950);cursor:pointer}
	.hw-scope .hw-poster img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;
	  display:block;max-width:100%;border:0}
	.hw-scope .hw-poster__veil{position:absolute;inset:0;
	  background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(15,29,23,.12) 0%,
	  rgba(15,29,23,.16) 55%,rgba(15,29,23,.72) 100%)}
	.hw-scope .hw-poster__play{position:absolute;top:50%;left:50%;
	  transform:translate(-50%,-50%);width:78px;height:78px;border-radius:50%;
	  border:1px solid rgba(246,243,236,.75);background:rgba(15,29,23,.42);
	  display:grid;place-items:center;color:var(--sand-100);font-size:20px;
	  padding-left:4px;
	  transition:transform var(--dur-base) var(--ease-standard),
	             background var(--dur-base) var(--ease-standard)}
	.hw-scope .hw-poster:hover .hw-poster__play,
	.hw-scope .hw-poster:focus-visible .hw-poster__play{
	  transform:translate(-50%,-50%) scale(1.06);background:rgba(15,29,23,.62)}
	.hw-scope .hw-poster__meta{position:absolute;left:var(--space-md);
	  right:var(--space-md);bottom:var(--space-md);display:grid;gap:.15rem;
	  text-align:left;pointer-events:none}
	/* Il poster e un <button>, e il kit maiuscola ogni pulsante del sito. Qui
	   dentro c'e il nome di una persona: va letto com'e scritto. */
	.hw-scope .hw-poster{text-transform:none;letter-spacing:normal;
	  font-weight:var(--fw-regular)}
	.hw-scope .hw-poster__nome{font-family:var(--font-heading);
	  font-size:var(--fs-h4);color:var(--sand-100);
	  text-transform:none;letter-spacing:normal;font-weight:var(--fw-regular)}
	.hw-scope .hw-poster__ruolo{font-family:var(--font-ui);
	  font-size:var(--fs-caption);color:var(--green-200);
	  text-transform:none;letter-spacing:normal;font-weight:var(--fw-regular)}
	@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){
	  .hw-scope .hw-poster:hover .hw-poster__play{transform:translate(-50%,-50%)}}
	.hw-scope .hw-btn__icon{display:inline-flex;
	  transition:transform var(--dur-base) var(--ease-standard)}
	.hw-scope a:hover .hw-btn__icon{transform:translateX(4px)}
	.hw-scope a:focus-visible{outline:none;
	  box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(192,138,74,.55);border-radius:2px}
	@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){
	  .hw-scope a:hover .hw-btn__icon{transform:none}}
	/* La lightbox sta in fondo al <body>, fuori da ogni sezione: le sue
	   regole non possono stare sotto .hw-scope. */
	/* Il riquadro del video vive attaccato al <body>, fuori da .hw-scope:
	   qui i selettori non possono partire da li, e senza precauzioni le
	   regole del kit — che vestono ogni <button> del sito — vincono. Il
	   pulsante di chiusura usciva fucsia, a pastiglia e in maiuscolo.
	   Ogni regola va quindi a due classi. */
	.hw-lightbox{position:fixed;inset:0;
	  /* sopra tutto: l'intestazione del sito e appiccicata in alto e con un
	     valore piu basso finiva davanti al video, proprio dove sta il
	     pulsante per chiudere */
	  z-index:999999;
	  background:rgba(9,18,14,.94);display:grid;place-items:center;
	  padding:clamp(1rem,4vw,3rem)}
	.hw-lightbox .hw-lightbox__box{position:relative;width:min(1100px,100%);
	  display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:.6rem}
	.hw-lightbox .hw-lightbox__frame{position:relative;aspect-ratio:16/9;
	  width:100%;background:#0f1d17;border-radius:12px;overflow:hidden}
	.hw-lightbox .hw-lightbox__frame iframe{position:absolute;inset:0;
	  width:100%;height:100%;border:0;z-index:1}
	/* Sopra la cornice, non dentro: Vimeo mette i propri comandi in alto a
	   destra — orologio e condivisione — e li stavamo coprendo. Fuori dal
	   video non puo sovrapporsi a niente, e ora che il riquadro sta sopra
	   l'intestazione quel posto e di nuovo raggiungibile.
	   In flusso normale, non in posizione assoluta: cosi su uno schermo
	   basso il riquadro si stringe invece di tagliarlo via. */
	.hw-lightbox .hw-lightbox__chiudi{align-self:flex-end;flex-shrink:0;
	  width:48px;height:48px;min-width:0;padding:0;
	  display:grid;place-items:center;
	  border-radius:50%;border:1px solid rgba(246,243,236,.45);
	  background:rgba(9,18,14,.72);color:#f6f3ec;
	  font-family:inherit;font-size:18px;font-weight:400;line-height:1;
	  text-transform:none;letter-spacing:normal;cursor:pointer;
	  transition:background .18s cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1)}
	.hw-lightbox .hw-lightbox__chiudi:hover,
	.hw-lightbox .hw-lightbox__chiudi:focus{background:rgba(9,18,14,.92);
	  border-color:rgba(246,243,236,.75);color:#f6f3ec}
	.hw-lightbox .hw-lightbox__chiudi:focus-visible{outline:none;
	  box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(192,138,74,.55)}
	</style>
				<style id="hw-hero-css">
